festivals.what: Morioka Sansa Odori, Chuo-dori, Morioka: 1 to 4 August, 6pm to 9pm (2026 was the 49th), with the drum parade on 4 August. If called off for rain it moves to Morioka Civic Culture Hall (Marios).
